title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #3

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Who should you give up your seat to? (1 mark)
   A. The loudest passenger
   B. Nobody
   C. A friend
   D. An elderly person or a pregnant woman

2. Which sacred river of India did the lesson say is honoured as a goddess in the stories? (1 mark)
   A. Ganga
   B. Rijubalika
   C. Beas
   D. Nzoia

3. Who was Sigala? (1 mark)
   A. A young man taught by the Buddha
   B. A Jain monk
   C. A king of Ayodhya
   D. A Sikh Guru

4. How many directions (groups of people) does the Sigalovada Sutta list? (1 mark)
   A. Nine
   B. Six
   C. Two
   D. Four

5. What does the book stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Food
   B. Knowledge
   C. Fire
   D. Rain

6. What does maha mean in Mahabhoot? (1 mark)
   A. New
   B. Old
   C. Great
   D. Small

7. Where was Prince Siddhartha born? (1 mark)
   A. Varanasi
   B. Lahore
   C. Amritsar
   D. Lumbini

8. What does Dainik mean? (1 mark)
   A. Weekly
   B. Monthly
   C. Daily
   D. Yearly

9. In which faith is the Rijubalika river important? (1 mark)
   A. Christianity
   B. Islam
   C. Sikhism
   D. Jainism

10. How can water be used in worship? (1 mark)
   A. To build the temple roof
   B. To make bells ring
   C. To burn incense
   D. To wash the hands and feet before prayer

11. What does karma mean? (1 mark)
   A. Water
   B. Action
   C. Wealth
   D. Prayer

12. The shopkeeper gives you Ksh 100 in change but you should get Ksh 70. What is the extra amount? (1 mark)
   A. Ksh 100
   B. Ksh 70
   C. Ksh 170
   D. Ksh 30

13. What does the story of Guru Nanak and Bhai Lalo teach? (1 mark)
   A. Rich people are wrong
   B. Cheating pays
   C. Honest earnings are best
   D. Wealth is proof of goodness

14. Which activity helps you learn the days and planets? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding the calendar
   B. Painting
   C. Copying from a book
   D. Making a decorated calendar

15. Shani is the Indian name for which planet? (1 mark)
   A. Mars
   B. Venus
   C. Saturn
   D. Jupiter

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain why balance is important in the four Purusharthas. (5 marks)

17. Explain how the days of the week are related to the solar system. (3 marks)

18. Explain why yoga should be practised with an expert. (4 marks)

19. Explain the meaning of Kapaal Bhaati. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — An elderly person or a pregnant woman
   Helping those who need seats shows kindness.

2. A — Ganga
   In the stories Ganga is honoured as a goddess.

3. A — A young man taught by the Buddha
   The talk was given to him.

4. B — Six
   It lists six groups.

5. B — Knowledge
   The book stands for knowledge.

6. C — Great
   Maha means great and bhoot means element.

7. D — Lumbini
   Lumbini is now in Nepal.

8. C — Daily
   Dainik means daily.

9. D — Jainism
   Jains believe Lord Mahavir became enlightened on its bank.

10. D — To wash the hands and feet before prayer
   Washing before prayer is a way of showing cleanliness and respect.

11. B — Action
   Karma is action and its results.

12. D — Ksh 30
   100 minus 70 is 30.

13. C — Honest earnings are best
   Honest work is valued.

14. D — Making a decorated calendar
   Decorating helps memory.

15. C — Saturn
   Shani is Saturn.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: Wealth and wishes are good but must follow Dharma. Without balance, chasing money or wishes can lead to cheating and harm, while Dharma keeps us honest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for balance, 2 marks for Dharma guiding the others, 2 marks for an example.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: They are named after the Sun, the Moon and five planets that people could see in the sky, so each day has a heavenly partner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for Sun and Moon, planets and naming.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: An expert shows the correct posture, corrects mistakes, prevents strain of the back or knees, and knows when to stop.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four points.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kapaal means forehead and bhaati means shining, so it means shining forehead. The breath goes out in short pushes and breathing in happens by itself.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for meaning, quick breath out and automatic breath in.
